title: US households using mobile/online banking as their main way to bank

source.name: FDIC National Survey of Unbanked and Underbanked Households

notes: Per FDIC survey data, the share of urban households using online or mobile banking as their most common way to access their account rose from 35.9% in 2013 to 54.9% in 2019. Rural households rose from 26.1% to 40.4% over the same period.
